_about: Authors whose pages are SHOWN WITH A LABEL in search results (field author_note). Nothing is hidden. Copy this file to labels.json and edit it; the next search uses it, no restart needed. An author's name must be written exactly as the index writes it (the semantic_books tool shows the names). The optional "kutub_slugs" lists the same authors by their author slug in the third library, which writes names in Latin letters.

labels.note: the note that will appear on every result from these authors
